{{Quote|The cat becomes the mouse.|[[Mori]] the Bastard|<ref name="SWG:SabttHDL">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Strike a blow to the Hidden Daggers Leadership|Corellian system}}</ref>}}
[[File:PsychoticJax.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Cats made vocalizations that sounded like "meow."]]
A '''cat''' was a type of domesticated animal that made vocalizations that sounded like "meow." [[Ken]] occasionally wished he possessed a cat or a [[Dog/Legends|dog]] instead of his pet [[Mooka/Legends|mooka]], [[Zeebo]].<ref name="Mooka">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref> The [[Spukami/Legends|spukamas]] was a common housecat on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Spukamas">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The [[pittin]] was another domesticated cat-like creature,<ref name="Pittin">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> as was the [[Felinx/Legends|felinx]]. Like cats, they came in many colors and enjoyed batting at strings.<ref name="Felinx">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref> [[Reekcat]]s were another species.<ref name="Reek">''[[The New Jedi Order: Recovery]]''</ref>

There were also several [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], such as the the [[Cantrosian]]s,<ref name="CN">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]],<ref name="TOTJ">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> the [[Tinnell]],<ref name="Tinn">{{JournalCite|1|Breaking Free: The Adventures of Dannen Lifehold}}</ref> and the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorians]].<ref name="TG">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref> Some cat-like sentient species, such as [[Orryxian]]s<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> and [[Catuman|Catumen]], were often nicknamed "Cats."<ref name="Ann">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 1]]</ref>
